item.title: LOT-184: On-demand « aperçu HFR » through POST /apercu.php (HFRClient flow, M5)

labels.name: origin: deliberate-gap
labels.description: Deliberate difference from legacy: (b) items, UXD evolutions, FEAT, M5, operator design choices

labels.name: status: on-hold
labels.description: Held by a decision (milestone not open, operator's call), not by a dependency

item.body:
### Summary As a poster, I want an « aperçu HFR » action in the composer that asks HFR itself to render my draft, so that I see the exact rendering when the local preview (LOT-097, labelled as a preview) is not enough. ### Scope Operator decision **O-1 = (b)** on [ADR 0014](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/442) (2026-11-02, recorded on #189 and #442): the local renderer plus this on-demand server preview. An evolution (the legacy app has no preview), so **M5**. - Module: `HFRClient` (session, `hash_check`, one `POST /apercu.php` per request; the answer's `body.reponse` goes through the LOT-034 normalizer and the reader path, like the local preview) · Difficulty: medium · Priority: low · **M5**. - Engine only: this lot delivers the `HFRClient` flow and its tests. LOT-152 (#242) adds the « aperçu HFR » action to its preview screen once the flow is merged; no dependency between the two lots (the local preview ships without it). - Spec: `docs/lots/LOT-184-apercu-server-preview.md` (stub in #442). ### Sources (captured) - HFR-PROTOCOL §6b "BBCode round trip": `POST /apercu.php`, form `apercu_form` of every composer (`hash_check`, `apercu_contenu`, `apercu_smiley` = `1`/`0`, `config`; `editPost.js` `apercevoir()`), answers 200 with the rendered message in `body.reponse` (`W61` → `R95d`, `W62` → `R95h`, #400 run 9). - The preview equals the thread page's message body once whitespace is removed, apart from the opening `

` (raw pages of #400); LOT-097's `BBCodeRendererOracleTests` already parse `R95d`/`R95h`. ### Depends on - LOT-097 (#189, the normalizer path and the oracle fixtures), LOT-044 (#70, session check before sending, LESSONS of #314), LOT-036 (#63, `hash_check` from the composer form, `R95c`/`R95f`). ### On hold Held by the M5_OPEN decision: M5 opens after the M4 parity is validated, and the orchestrator opens it (operator decisions of 2026-11-02 on #379). ([decision](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/issues/379#issuecomment-6573879240)) ### Model Opus → Fable (state-changing-shaped flow: session and token; AGENTS.md §6). ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] `HFRClient` flow: given a composer form and the account's session, one POST, typed outcome (`MessageContent` through the normalizer, or a typed failure: session, token, network). `/apercu.php` writes nothing (`R95d.meta.json`), so a failed exchange is a plain failure the member may retry; the LOT-048 write rule does not apply. - [ ] Differential tests on `R95d`/`R95h` and on every captured failure state; the public entry point tested with a session that may only contact the loopback host. - [ ] HFR-PROTOCOL §6c `### LOT-184` with the verified facts; CHANGELOG-LEGACY line (new behaviour). - [ ] The draft leaves the device only when the member asks for this preview (ADR 0014 §4 "Local and silent" stays true for the local one). --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
